name: SiteTree
purpose: provide one human-editable canonical authority for the public site hierarchy and deterministic derived projections

nodeSemantics.id: canonical node identity inside the SiteTree instance
nodeSemantics.label: canonical public label for the node
nodeSemantics.path: public path when the node is addressable

rules: /site.json is site instance data and must not live under /lib/webengine/
SiteTree is the only canonical public hierarchy authority
Navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap are derived from SiteTree
derived projections may be duplicated; hierarchy authority may not
public means exposed or addressable and does not imply anonymous access
public topic architecture and technical/runtime ownership are separate layers
API and service routing are separate machine-interface concerns and must not be inferred from SiteTree
invalid or ambiguous SiteTree data must not be repaired by inventing a second hierarchy
SiteTree must not infer authorization from hierarchy, paths or visibility
